i.norm: Tag lookup must be case-insensitive in HTML: "script" and "SCRIPT" should resolve to the same tag. When looked up via a TagSet the two calls must return the exact same instance (assertSame), whereas the static Tag.valueOf path only guarantees equality (assertEquals).
Static valueOf normalises the tag name, so both inputs produce equal Tags.
TagSet caches instances, so the same normalised name must yield the identical object.
